t.zh: 「当且仅当」把两个方向的「若…则…」合成一句。
t.en: “If and only if” makes one sentence of the “if … then” both ways.

t.zh: 板上这份「当且仅当」的声明不符合需求。请从引入和使用两个方向各写一条检验条例，找出它的错误。
t.en: The declaration of “if and only if” on the board does not meet the requirement. Write a test case for each direction, introduction and use, to find its fault.

brief.zh: 需求：「下雨当且仅当地湿」：两个方向的「若…则…」都已证出，才能引入。编写两条检验条例，使预期符合需求，这份声明的结果都和预期不符。
brief.en: Requirement: “it rains if and only if the ground is wet” may be introduced only when the “if … then” both ways are proved. Write two test cases whose expectations meet the requirement and with which this declaration’s results both disagree.

hint.zh: 这份声明的两条引入规则，各要一样还是两样？
hint.en: Does each of this declaration’s two introduction rules need one thing or two?

hint.zh: 有了「下雨 ↔ 地湿」，按需求可以从「地湿」推出什么？这份声明的消去规则每种情况交还什么？
hint.en: With “it rains ↔ the ground is wet”, what follows from “the ground is wet” by the requirement? What does each case of this declaration’s elimination rule hand back?

t.zh: 前提不必是一个字母，也可以是含 → 的句子：在前提的窗口里用连接词拼出来。规则只写一层 ⟹，前提里再要什么，就写进句子里。
t.en: A premise need not be a single letter; it can be a sentence with → in it, built with the connective in the premise window. A rule is written with one layer of ⟹; whatever a premise needs in turn goes inside its sentence.

brief.zh: 需求：「下雨当且仅当地湿」：两个方向的「若…则…」都已证出，才能引入。写出「当且仅当」的声明。
brief.en: Requirement: “it rains if and only if the ground is wet” may be introduced only when the “if … then” both ways are proved. Write the declaration of “if and only if”.

hint.zh: 需求要的两样，是同时都要，还是有一样就够？
hint.en: Does the requirement need both at once, or is either enough?
